projects.name: FREX Club
projects.Project_Overview: FREX Club lets businesses run their own loyalty programs while customers keep their cards and benefits in one Flutter wallet. I was the sole freelance developer responsible for planning, the Laravel panel and API, the app, and technical handoff. Three decisions shaped the MVP: one customer identity with independent memberships per business; a points ledger corrected through new adjustments rather than overwritten history; and checkout operations performed by staff while customers consult their balances and rewards. General and birthday promotions were added in later iterations. The portfolio period is June–September 2026; the interface captures and conceptual promotional film represent later work from October 2026 and use demonstration data.
projects.description: End-to-end development of a loyalty platform: Laravel business administration, a protected REST API and a Flutter wallet for customer cards, points, rewards and promotions.
responsibilities: Define the MVP with distinct platform, business, staff and customer roles, keeping checkout and subscription activation manual in the initial scope.
Model a global customer identity with separate company memberships, branded cards, balances and reward catalogs.
Implement earned points, staff-assisted redemption and an append-only ledger, using adjustments and reversals to preserve transaction history.
Build the Laravel administration panel, protected REST API and Flutter wallet, including magic-link access and secure session storage.
Extend the initial product with general and birthday promotions based on subsequent requirements, keeping business configuration and customer presentation connected.
Document API contracts, operation, architecture and delivery; support product communication with a later conceptual promotional film.
achievements: Delivered a connected business platform and customer app independently, from scope definition to technical handoff.
Supported several loyalty memberships for one customer while preserving each business’s independent points and benefits.
Made checkout operations traceable through a history of earned points, redemptions, adjustments and reversals.
Extended the MVP with documented promotion flows and explained the product to business buyers through a conceptual promotional film.

quick_view.summary: A complete loyalty product: Laravel administration, a protected API and a native Flutter wallet for cards, points and rewards.

The platform provides a structured database with detailed information on degree programs, admission requirements, costs, and institutional details. It offers intuitive search and filtering options, allowing students to compare different programs efficiently. Additionally, the platform enhances accessibility by enabling students to download academic plans and set reminders for key enrollment deadlines.

projects.name: EZTICKET - Event Ticketing and Access Control Platform
projects.Project_Overview: EZTICKET is a full-stack event ticketing platform built to centralize the publication, sale, and validation of event tickets. The system supports three operational roles: Administrator, Client, and Receptionist/Validator. It includes a public-facing website, seat and section-based ticket purchasing, Mercado Pago checkout, digital ticket issuance with QR codes, access validation, live event metrics, exportable reports, legal document management, and a virtual queue to handle traffic peaks.
projects.description: Development of a production-ready web platform for event organizers to manage artists, venues, seating layouts, events, purchases, and access validation. The system combines a public event catalog with an administrative panel and receptionist module, enabling end-to-end operations from event publication to ticket validation and post-sale reporting.
responsibilities: Develop the public experience for browsing events, viewing event details, and purchasing tickets by section or assigned seat.
Build the administrative panel to manage artists, venues, events, sections, rows, seating layouts, purchases, branding, and legal documents.
Integrate Mercado Pago for checkout, payment status handling, webhook processing, and reservation release on failed or expired payments.
Implement QR code generation and digital ticket rendering for approved purchases, including access-point validation flows for reception staff.
Create event metrics and reporting modules with sales summaries, attendance validation data, and Excel export support.
Develop a virtual queue system with heartbeat tracking and availability checks to protect the purchase flow during traffic spikes.
Model and maintain database structures for events, venues, tickets, validations, user tracking, and purchase lifecycles.
achievements: Delivered a production-ready platform that unified event publishing, online sales, digital ticket delivery, and access control in a single system.
Implemented a complete end-to-end ticketing flow from selection and payment to QR issuance and on-site validation.
Improved operational control for administrators through live event metrics, purchase tracking, and exportable reports.
Added automatic reservation expiration and release logic to recover inventory and prevent blocked seats during incomplete payments.
Enabled the platform to handle high-demand scenarios through a virtual queue and traffic monitoring workflow.

quick_view.summary: Ticketing platform covering public event discovery, seat selection, checkout, QR issuance, and live access validation.
